column1: # MORPHOLOGY OF THE GPT STORY -- v2
# Column 1 = id, column 2 = gloss. FACET prefix keeps Propp's two systems apart:
#   F_  function      what happens. These have an ORDER.
#   P_  persona       who acts. No order.
# (room) = written at Bergen.  (added) = proposed from US_1 and IN_1.

column2: the protagonist cannot do the thing they are for: writer's block, lost voice, stalled work (room)
the protagonist is moved by not-knowing; a question, a rumour, an unexplained thing (room)
someone wants what the community does not sanction: education, a marriage, leaving (room)
an inheritance is felt as an obligation the protagonist has not met (added: Benny and his father's house and vocation)
a physical thing passed down is carried, opened or used (added: the grandmother's journal, the father's coin)
an older figure names a task, a place or a direction (room)
a non-human agency speaks, appears or acts (room: whispering pines)
a written or remembered record is consulted (room)
a named local myth is recounted TO the protagonist as prior knowledge (added: the Maplewood Well, the Whispering Pines)
something of the protagonist's is given up to obtain the outcome (added: the coin thrown into the well)

landscape or weather is given voice, memory or intention (added)
narration moves to feeling, memory or realisation (added: the single most frequent move in both)
